text:
{
  "status": "partial",
  "rpwd_relevant_sections": [
    "Section 16(iii): Duty of educational institutions to provide reasonable accommodation according to the individual's requirements",
    "Section 16(iv): Duty to provide necessary support, individualized or otherwise, in environments that maximize academic and social development",
    "Section 17(a): Specific measures to conduct periodic surveys, train teachers, and provide resource support including therapeutic services"
  ],
  "ncte_relevant_sections": [
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.30): Providing adequate facility of resource persons and frequency of support such as occupational therapists, speech therapists, and psychologists",
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.30): Transacting curriculum through total communication approach and UDL-based whole class/differentiated approach",
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.39): Capacity building of teachers to identify learning needs and provide contextualized, accessible teaching-learning activities"
  ],
  "identified_gaps": [
    "Omission of specific therapeutic support services (e.g., Occupational Therapy for sensory processing dysregulation) including designated frequency and duration of service.",
    "Lack of explicit specification regarding special education teacher (SET) involvement and resource room support frequency in alignment with RPwD Section 17 and NCTE guidelines."
  ],
  "mandatory_accommodations": [
    "Noise-canceling headphones and designated quiet work space for auditory sensory regulation (RPwD Act Section 16(iii))",
    "Visual schedules and structured advance notifications for routine transitions (NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p.30)",
    "Adult-facilitated peer cooperative activities and structured lunch/recess interest groups (RPwD Act Section 16(i) & 16(iv))"
  ],
  "compliance_notes": "The IEP successfully identifies essential behavioral, social, and sensory accommodations (visual schedules, sensory aids, peer clubs). However, it falls short of full legal compliance under RPwD Act Sections 16/17 and NCTE/NCERT Guidelines due to the absence of documented therapeutic support (such as Occupational Therapy) and explicit frequency/duration metrics for specialized resource personnel."
}
